en: Vimānavatthu: The Mansion of the Man,
Chapter on Well-Placed [Offerings]
3. The Mansion with Jewel Pillars “High indeed is this mansion with jewel pillars,
extending twelve yojanas in every direction.”
Seven hundred magnificent gabled halls,
beautiful with pillars of beryl and adorned with golden ornaments;
there you eat, drink, and enjoy yourself.
Divine lutes resound with lovely tones;
here are the five divine qualities of sensual pleasure,
and women adorned in gold dance.
“By what means do you have such a complexion...
[and] why does your complexion illuminate all directions?”
Thus the young deva was delighted...
[as before] ...the fruit of which action this is.
“Having become a human among humans,
I made a path through the wilderness;
I shall plant groves and trees.”
And those who were virtuous were dear to me;
with a confident heart, I gave abundant gifts of food and drink with due respect.
"Because of that, my complexion is such as this...
and my complexion shines forth in all directions."
The third is the Maṇithūṇa Vimāna.
